_readme: GST rates as data (AGENTS.md rule 4). Every entry needs source, effectiveFrom, lastChecked and reviewedBy. The calculator also accepts a custom rate, because the rate for a specific item depends on its HSN/SAC classification.
note: Rates after the GST Council's 56th meeting. Pan masala, gutkha, cigarettes, chewing tobacco and some other tobacco items moved to the new structure on a later date notified separately; check the current notification for them.

sources.title: PIB: Recommendations of the 56th Meeting of the GST Council
